def fact(x):
    f=1
    for i in range(1,x+1):
        f=f*i
    return f
def neper():
    s1=1
    s2=2
    i=2
    while abs(s2-s1)>=0.0001:
        s1=s2
        s2=s1+(1/fact(i))
        i=i+1
    return s2
#Programme principale
print(neper())
